posts.title: Retroshield 6800 is running FLEX 2.0
posts.description: I LOVE Retroshields! Not because I made them but they makes debugging HW/SW so easy and very educational. Recently, I was bringing up the Retroshield 6800 prototype. I quickly got MIKBUG and SWTBUG running. Next step was to run FLEX 2.0 using the DSK images on Teensy sdcard. posts.title: Teensy 4.1 speaks Transputer Link
posts.description: Typical transputer reference designs use IMS C011 (or IMS C012) link adapter chips (from INMOS) to connect the transputer to a HOST (PC) where the iserver application downloads the boot code and afterwards provides storage/console services over the link.
